entities.name: Siege of Serdica (809)
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The siege of Serdica took place in the spring of 809 at modern Sofia, Bulgaria. As a result, the city was annexed to the Bulgarian State and remained so until the fall of the First Bulgarian Empire.
